npcs.name: Lab aide

004.name: Dustmere Plaza

Bram: The drift grass crackles with blue sparks. That's how you know Alienmon are hiding in it!
npcs.name: Bram
pre: Kid: You're getting your first Alienmon today? Lucky! Dr. Vashti's lab is the dome with the telescope.

t: Mr. Abernathy: Honey rolls, fresh out of the oven! First one's free for anybody with a brand-new partner.

npcs.name: Mr. Abernathy

Girl: When it's sleepy it rolls into the shade. When it's happy it rolls into ME.
Girl: DX-4 keeps wandering off toward the bridge. Pebblet follows him. I follow Pebblet.
npcs.name: Rock-girl

t: Linker: Press START to check your team. A tired Alienmon is a fainted Alienmon waiting to happen.
Woman: The shop dome sells Stasis Pods. You can't catch anything without them!
Woman: Weaken an Alienmon first. A full-health one just pops right back out.
Watchman: West of here is the landing pad. Ships only leave with launch clearance from a Keeper.
DX-4: Bzzt! Scout unit DX-4 online.
DX-4: The bridge crosses the canyon to the east trading post. Mind the lava falls!
npcs.name: DX-4

t: Dusty: Name's Dusty. I've lived on this rim since the Starfall.
Dusty: That crater past the falls? The seedpods came down hot as stars twenty years back.
npcs.name: Old Dusty

t: Kit: I'm keeper of the Shards now. ...Okay, I gave myself that job. But somebody has to!
Kit: Dad gave me his old welding goggles. They're too big. I'm keeping them.
npcs.name: Kit

A ladder leads up to the attic.

t: Nurse: Welcome to the Recovery Bay! Step up to the counter and I'll heal your team.
npcs.name: Nurse

t: Trainer: I come here after every route. Healing is free, so there's no excuse to push your luck.
Shopkeeper: Talk to me at the counter for pods and potions!
npcs.name: Shopkeeper

t: Shopper: Gels heal, Cure Spray fixes poison and burns. I always carry both.

007.name: Dustmere Bridge

t: Hiker: Don't look down. That canyon goes all the way to the old lava falls.
Bridge keeper: This bridge was built by Ferrox steelworkers. Not a single rivet has slipped in forty years.

008.name: Trading Post

objects.why: house door: Trading Post dome (shared Dustara home)
house door: Trading Post dome (shared Dustara home)

Trader: Everything here came over the Molten Frontier on a cart. Prices reflect the danger!
npcs.name: Snack trader

t: Kid: The lemonade stand? That was... an accident. Mostly the lamb's fault.
npcs.name: Kid with a lamb

t: Miner: The Sunset Tunnel past the cactus gardens is the only way through to the Frontier on foot.

Referee: ...And no knocking over my lemonade stand AGAIN.
npcs.name: Referee

t: Fenna: Spores, roots, a few mushrooms that hum. I trade them for anything shiny.
Fenna: Sporeholm grows mushrooms bigger than houses. Bigger than Dustmere, nearly!
npcs.name: Fenna

009.name: Rimwalk Trail Part A
009.notes: Canyon-rim route with drift grass, ledges you hop down, trainers

t: Hiker: The Rimwalk Trail hugs the canyon edge. Great view, terrible place to trip.
Birdwatcher: I've seen Alienmon with wings riding the thermals over the canyon.

010.name: Rimwalk Trail Part B
010.notes: Canyon-rim route with drift grass, ledges you hop down, trainers

t: Researcher: Different grass patches hold different Alienmon. Try them all!
Camper: If you're low on health, head back to Dustmere. Pride is not a healing item.

011.name: Cactus Gardens
011.notes: Maze of tall cacti and flowering succulents, drift grass, hidden items

t: Gardener: These cacti store water for months. Some Alienmon nest right inside them.
Explorer: The Sunset Tunnel is just east. Bring light, it's a maze in there.

012.name: Sunset Tunnel B1
012.notes: Sandstone tunnel to the Molten Frontier; lantern-lit, boulders

t: Miner: Watch your step. The lanterns down here run on crystal shards.

013.name: Sunset Tunnel B2
013.notes: Sandstone tunnel to the Molten Frontier; lantern-lit, boulders

t: Old miner: You can feel the heat from here. The Molten Frontier is right above us.

014.name: Molten Frontier: Tunnel Mouth
014.notes: Exit of Sunset Tunnel onto volcanic far side

t: Guard: Welcome to the Molten Frontier. Stick to the trails and stay off anything glowing.
Traveller: The ash trail east leads to Palm Isle and Port Ember. Rest up there.
Guard: You're entering the Molten Frontier.
Helix built their forge fortress at the top of the ridge. Watch yourself up there.
Miner: That tunnel runs all the way under the sea to Sunset Canyon.
The ground's been rumbling since Helix started digging.

015.name: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part A

t: Ash walker: The ash makes everything look grey, but the Alienmon out here are anything but dull.
Sporefolk: Even here, spores find a way. The red blooms feed on lava heat.

016.name: Molten Frontier: Ash Trail Part B

t: Nomad: Magma-types love the warm ground. Hydro moves cool them off fast.
Geologist: These vents breathe every few minutes. Count to ten and you'll see.
Bug Catcher Grub: Fire bugs! The hottest bugs! Battle me!

017.name: Molten Frontier: Palm Isle
017.notes: Tropical island with Recovery Hut, palm trees, turquoise water

objects.why: Palm Isle Recovery Hut (works like the counter)

t: Nurse Coral: Welcome to the Palm Isle Recovery Hut! Let me patch your team up.
npcs.name: Nurse Coral

t: Nurse Coral: Wait. Is that... R.B. No. 1? That's Wren's badge!
Nurse Coral: I was her apprentice at the Dustmere Recovery Bay the night the stars fell. She taught me everything.
Nurse Coral: You've got her eyes. Come here, let me patch your team up. For Wren.
Islander: Palm Isle is the only green spot for miles. The Recovery Hut here has saved a lot of Linkers.

Explorer: The hut here is a Recovery Hut. Rest up before you head into the lava fields.
Weaken a wild Alienmon with a Tether Pulse, shock it with a Stun Spray, then fire the transfer beam!
Pilgrim Sol: The island spirits test every traveler. Let's battle!

018.name: Molten Frontier: Port Ember
018.notes: Harbor village with the harbor Relay Gate (needs 2 Shards)

objects.why: Port Ember healing centre (shared Recovery Bay room)
Port Ember healing centre (shared Recovery Bay room)

t: Sailor: The Deep Sea Ferry leaves from the long dock. Only cleared Linkers ride, though.
Dock mechanic: Helix boats have been prowling the harbor. Keep your pods close.
Fish seller: Fresh from the ember sea! Well... warm from the ember sea.
Harbor guard: Port Ember's been a safe harbor for a hundred years. We intend to keep it that way.
Linker: Every Keeper you beat gives you a Signal Shard. Eight of them and something big happens. Nobody agrees on what.
Villager: Welcome to Port Ember, the last calm shore before the lava fields.
Mina: This hood? It's a shark. Obviously. The fish respect it.
Mina: Cast past the end of the boardwalk and wait. Something on Thalassa always bites back.
npcs.name: Mina

019.name: Molten Frontier: Long Dock
019.notes: Long wooden dock where the Deep Sea Ferry berths (M08 Sola's Choice scene)

Squid Sailor: The ferry at the end of this dock sails to the Deep Sea Ruins.
Hop aboard whenever you're ready.

020.name: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part A

Researcher Kel: Lava-forged Alienmon have incredible stats. Let me show you!

021.name: Molten Frontier: Ridge Path Part B

t: Scout: I saw Helix grunts hauling crates toward the fortress. Something's being built in there.
Wanderer: The paths wind down the ridge to the Forge Gate and the shuttle pad.
Wild Alienmon roam the trails between towns. Keep your team healthy.

022.name: Molten Frontier: Forge Gate
022.notes: Ystran Relay Gate to Ferrox, guarded by Forge Miner Dax

Gate guard: No clearance, no passage. Those are the rules.
Forge Miner Dax: The gate's mine to guard. Beat me first!

023.name: Molten Frontier: Fortress Gate
023.notes: Helix Forge Fortress entrance, Helix grunt guard

t: Refugee: Helix took the old forge and turned it into a fortress. We had to leave everything.
Helix Grunt: Halt! This forge belongs to the Helix Directive.

npcs.name: Helix Grunt

t: Helix Grunt: Halt! This forge belongs to the Helix Directive!
Former Helix worker: Helix is finished. I just want to fix things now.
Grub: Psst. I used to work in that Forge. I know a way in.
Grub: Beat the grunt at the door, then find the control room terminal. The keycard is in there.
npcs.name: Grub

024.name: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part A

t: Bridge tech: These lava bridges are cooled by pumps. If they stop, run.

025.name: Molten Frontier: Lava Bridges Part B

t: Linker: Almost at the shuttle pad. Ships to the far planets launch from there.
Technician: This dish relays every signal in the Frontier.
Lately it keeps catching a pulse from the Starfall crater. Same rhythm, every night.

026.name: Molten Frontier: Shuttle Pad
026.notes: Fortress Shuttle Pad to Helix Station

Helix deserter: I flew shuttles for Helix. Never again. Ask me nothing about the Director.
Strand: Helix shuttles fly from this pad straight to the Starfall Rift.
Whatever they're hauling out there, they don't want anyone to see.

027.name: Molten Frontier: Shadow Tunnel Mouth
027.notes: Dark tunnel mouth leading to Umbra

t: Lantern keeper: The Shadow Tunnel leads to Umbra. The dark in there plays tricks on you.

028.name: Molten Frontier: Magma Mines Gate
028.notes: Sealed glowing-red Ystran door to Pyros

Ystran echo: ...the mountain's heart burns like Ystra's dying sun...
...the Magma Mines go deeper than anyone has dared...
Gate guard: Welcome to Ferrox. Mind the rails, the ore carts don't stop for anyone.
Porter: Everything that lands here gets weighed, stamped and argued over. That's Ferrox for you.
Traveller: First time on Ferrox? Rustvale is just east. Best scrap stew in the system.

030.name: Rustvale
030.notes: Shanty town of shacks and converted rail cars

t: Scrapper: Everything here is built from junk. Even the Relay Tower.
Rail hand: Alloy-types love the rail yard. Bring something that burns.
Kid: Hank's Alienmon are tough as old boilers!
Watchman: Helix suits were sniffing around the crane yard last night. Hank's not happy.
Old welder: Hank Briggs runs the tower at the end of Furnace Ridge. You'll need a Shard's worth of guts to face him.
Linker: Magma moves melt Alloy-types fast. Volt moves just bounce off.
Kit: Dad says I can fix anything except my own room.
Kit: My {kit} sniffs out loose bolts. It's better at it than me!
npcs.name: Kit

t: Nurse: Welcome to the Rustvale Recovery Bay. Step up to the counter!
npcs.name: Nurse

t: Miner: I patch up my Alienmon here after every shift. The nurse doesn't even charge for the soot.
Shopkeeper: Pods, gels, sprays. Talk to me at the counter.
npcs.name: Shopkeeper

t: Customer: Stun Spray is a lifesaver on the Scrap Route. Those junk-types hit hard.
Grub: Mind the parts. Half of these are holding the other half together.
Grub: Come back when you've seen a bit more of Ferrox. I might have work for you.
npcs.name: Grub

t: Tower engineer: Hank's apprentices train on this floor. The Keeper waits upstairs.

t: Dock tech: Ships set down on the pad here. Mirefen Village is just east along the boardwalk.
Bog hiker: Stay on the planks. The bog looks like moss, but it's mostly water and bad decisions.

042.notes: Stilt village of huts on mushroom stalks with rope bridges

Villager: The dome with the cyan cross is the Recovery Bay. Rest up before you head into the marsh.
Grandmother: My grandson swears he was lost in the Mushroom Maze for a whole day. It was an hour.
Pilgrim: I came to hear the Spore Choir at the pools. On still nights the spores hum in harmony.
Man in a white coat: Helix? Never heard of them. I'm just... sampling the mushrooms. For science.
Traveler: The Keeper here guards a Signal Shard. Climb her tower and she'll test you herself.

Lost hiker: I've passed that stone shrine three times. I'm starting to think it follows me.
Lab aide: Dr. Moor's apprentices guard this floor. Beat them and the stairs to her lab are yours.

t: Lab aide: Beat Dr. Moor and she'll hand over Sporeholm's Signal Shard. Bring Cure Spray. Trust me.

objects.why: V2: the dock Recovery Bay (shared room)

Mechanic: Captain Marsh's tower relays signals for the whole system. Or it did, till Helix came.
Traveller: Keepers guard the Relay Towers. Win and they hand you a Signal Shard.

Storyteller: They say Anchorath sleeps under the sea arch, and the tide turns when it dreams.
Nurse: Welcome to the Saltreach Recovery Bay. Your Alienmon will be shipshape in no time.

Clerk: Ahoy! Pods, potions, rope, bait. Everything a Linker needs before the coral route.

Deckhand: Captain Marsh is upstairs. Helix ripped the core right out of this tower. She's furious.

objects.why: Keeper on the pool steps, challenged from (11,11)

t: First mate: The Captain fights with the tide behind her. Volt types might give you a chance.

062.name: Neonis Starport

Dr. Vashti: Keep going, Linker. Every Shard brings us closer to the truth.
npcs.name: Dr. Vashti

t: Dock tech: Ships land on that orange ring. Stand clear unless you like being flattened.
Dock tech: The whole deck floats on Volt power. If the lights flicker, hold onto something.

Raver: First time on Neonis? The city never sleeps. Neither do I, apparently.

Signal researcher: Every Relay Tower picks up the same pulse, every eight seconds. Spooky, right?
Traveller: The dome with the cross is the Recovery Bay. It heals your whole team for free. Use it!

Raver: The whole city hums with Volt energy. Feel it? That buzz in your teeth?
Coder: Every sign in Neonis runs on Alienmon power. They get paid in snacks. Good snacks.
Courier: The Arcade District is east. Trainers there love a surprise battle.
Tourist: Volt types hate ground moves. Remember that before you climb Voltspire.
Street vendor: Neon noodles! You glow for an hour after eating. Totally safe. Mostly.
Archivist: Signal Shards are said to resonate with each other. Collect them and listen closely.
Suspicious man: Helix? Never heard of it. I just... like dark uniforms. Move along.

Raver: Three battles in a row at the Arcade. My Alienmon needed a nap. So did I.
Clerk: Welcome to the Neonis Shop! Stasis Pods, potions, all the essentials.
Shopper: Stock up before Voltspire. Static's team hits hard and fast.
Gamer: High score on Star Saucer 3! ...Okay, second highest. A Coder beat me with a macro.
Repair coder: Glitchy Alienmon hide in the static. A weakened one is easier to catch in a Stasis Pod.
Courier: Trainers battle you if you walk into their line of sight. Fight, or sneak around them.
Stage guard: Welcome to Voltspire! The Keeper waits at the top. Heal up before you climb.
Sound tech: Feel that bass? That's the reactor below us. Static tunes it like an instrument.

Ferry hand: The Deep Sea Ferry runs here and back. Nobody else is brave enough to sail these ruins.

npcs.name: Nurse

077.name: Glyph Hollow

Guardian Stone: The carving shows a ring of stones around a sleeping seed.
Pilgrim: The Guardian Stones circle the hollow. Some say they still guard something sleeping.
Archaeologist: The glowing door up the steps leads to the Mural Hall. Go look. Really look.

078.name: Temple of Voices 1F

079.name: Temple of Voices 2F

Pilgrim: The chimes fell silent ages ago. They say a Chimelet's song could wake them.

Kid: ...Mom says no.

npcs.name: Dig Chief

t: Greeter: Welcome to Sporeholm! Please don't step on the glowing moss. It bruises.
Greeter: The bog is safest on the lit paths. The mushroom lamps show the way.
npcs.name: Greeter

t: Mushroom Keeper: Oh! A guest inside my mushroom. Mind the jars, they're full of spores.
Mushroom Keeper: This mushroom was growing before my grandmother was born. It's still growing now.
npcs.name: Mushroom Keeper

186.name: Umbra House
186.notes: Shared house interior: every house door on Umbra opens here

t: Lamplighter: Come in, come in. On Umbra we keep every lamp lit, all night long.
Lamplighter: The Devourer follows the light, they say. So we never let it go out.
npcs.name: Lamplighter

t: Canyon Guide: Shoes off, the rug's my grandma's. Oven's always warm if you're hungry.
Canyon Guide: When the drift grass crackles at night, the Starfall Crater is glowing.
npcs.name: Canyon Guide

t: Scrap Welder: Every bolt in this cabin came off a crashed freighter. Hank says it's the sturdiest house on Ferrox.
Scrap Welder: Mind the stove. It runs on old reactor cores.
npcs.name: Scrap Welder

t: Crystal Keeper: These crystals grew from the old world-tree's sap. They still hum when an Alienmon walks by.
Crystal Keeper: Ystra was green once. Listen closely and you can hear it remembering.
npcs.name: Crystal Keeper

t: Moss Tender: The lamps are glowcaps. Pick one and it sulks for a week.
Moss Tender: Sit, sit. The tea is mostly spores, but the good kind.
npcs.name: Moss Tender

t: Old Netmender: You can see the whole bay from that window. Captain Marsh's boat comes in at dawn.
Old Netmender: If you hear singing under the pier, that's just the Gloopa. Probably.
npcs.name: Old Netmender

t: Late-Night Coder: Every screen in this place is tuned to DJ Static's channel. Rent includes the bass.
Late-Night Coder: The crystal on the table charges my phone. Don't tell the landlord.
npcs.name: Late-Night Coder

t: Ice Fisher: Fire's always lit. The blue flame burns colder than you'd think, but it keeps the frost off.
Ice Fisher: Ingrid digs fossils all winter. I just dig holes and wait for fish.
npcs.name: Ice Fisher

t: Resident: Rustvale Lane Homes are built from old boilers. Warm in winter, toasty in summer!
Resident: The spaceport's just past the last house.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I'm building a robot out of spare parts. It doesn't move yet. Or ever.
npcs.name: Kid

t: Neighbour: Rustvale's just down the road if you need the Recovery Bay.
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Junk dealer: One Linker's trash is another Linker's treasure. Mostly it's just trash.
Shopper: I came for a bolt and left with a jetpack. It doesn't work, but still.
Ore trader: Ferrox ore powers half the ships in the system. Helix wants all of it.
Fortune teller: I see... a tower. And a man with a very large wrench.
Farmer: Turnips grow tough in Ferrox soil. Tough enough to dent a wrench!
Farmer: The Scrapyard Dome is right next door. Noisy neighbors!
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: Our goats eat tin cans. Mom says that's normal here.
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Scavenger: The Scrap Route is all junk piles and loose rails. Alienmon love hiding in the scrap.
Hauler: My cart threw a wheel. Again. Third time this week.
Crane operator: Three junkers keep jamming my cranes. Hank wants them taught a lesson.
Yard guard: No Helix allowed in this yard. Not after what they pulled last month.
Wanderer: Scrap Hollow Grove. Trees growing right through old gears. Isn't it wonderful?
Wanderer: Swarm-types build nests in the hollow pipes.
npcs.name: Wanderer

t: Picnicker: Crane Overlook is too windy for lunch. This spot is perfect!
npcs.name: Picnicker

t: Miner: Deepcut Mine is right below. Grab a helmet if you've got one.
Miner: Crane Overlook is back up the hill.
npcs.name: Miner

t: Rail Hand: The old cart rails go all the way down. Don't ride them. Trust me.
npcs.name: Rail Hand

t: Miner: B1's got the loose rocks. Alloy-types chew on 'em like snacks.
Miner: Stairs to B2 are deeper in.
npcs.name: Miner

t: Tunnel Digger: B2 is hot and dusty. The Depths are just below.
Tunnel Digger: Keep a Potion handy. Things down there hit hard.
npcs.name: Tunnel Digger

t: Spelunker: You made it to the Depths! The ore down here sparkles like stars.
npcs.name: Spelunker

t: Hiker: Tall rust-grass is where the wild ones hide. Walk around it if your team is tired.
Drifter: The crane yard's next. Watch for falling crates.
Fan: The Scrapyard Dome is built from old train cars. Loudest arena in Rustvale!
Fan: The lobby's right through the iron gate.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Scrapper: Every bolt in that dome came from the junk heaps. Even the seats!
npcs.name: Scrapper

t: Snack Trader: Grilled corn on a stick! Great for battle watching!
npcs.name: Snack Trader

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Scrapyard Dome! The arena is through those doors.
Receptionist: No climbing on the scrap walls, please. It's for decoration!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I've got a sign that says CRUSH IT. Get it? Because Alloy-types?
npcs.name: Fan

t: Furnace worker: The heat up here peels paint off ships. Keep your Alienmon hydrated.
Guard: Ferrox Tower is just ahead. Hank Briggs is the Keeper. Good luck, kid.
Scrapper: The Back Lot is where the junk goes to sleep. Some of it snores.
Scrapper: Funny, that door over there used to be locked.
npcs.name: Scrapper

t: Mechanic: Railyard Junction is back the way you came. Watch for trains!
npcs.name: Mechanic

t: Helix Scientist: What? This lab is perfectly ordinary. Stop looking at the beakers.
Helix Scientist: Fine, fine. Touch nothing and we'll get along.
npcs.name: Helix Scientist

t: Salvage Trader: Welcome to the Salvage Shop! One Linker's junk is another Linker's treasure.
Salvage Trader: We don't sell this stuff. We just admire it. Mostly.
npcs.name: Salvage Trader

t: Mechanic: The Engine Garage fixes anything with wheels, gears, or a stubborn attitude.
Mechanic: Volt-types are great at jump-starting engines!
npcs.name: Mechanic

t: Apprentice: I'm only allowed to hand over wrenches. Someday I'll fix a whole engine!
npcs.name: Apprentice

t: Crane Operator: This is my bunk. Small, but I can see the whole yard from my window.
Crane Operator: Swinging a crane all day makes for great naps.
npcs.name: Crane Operator

t: Farmer: We grow desert melons out here. Sweet as honey and twice as sticky!
Farmer: The plaza's up the road if you need supplies.
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: My chore is chasing Swarm-types out of the melon patch. They always come back!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Resident: Dustmere Lane is quiet in the day and busy at sundown. Everyone hides from the heat!
Resident: The farmstead is just down the road.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I saw a Volt-type spark in the drift grass! Bet you can't catch it!
npcs.name: Kid

t: Old Resident: Dustmere Quiet Court is for folks who like a good nap.
Old Resident: Oasis Fork is just over yonder if you need water.
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Gardener: Cactus gardens are easy. Just don't hug them.
npcs.name: Gardener

t: Oasis Hermit: You found the Hidden Mesa Grove! Not many folks wander off the Oasis Shore this far.
Oasis Hermit: Rare Bio-types nap in the palm shade.
npcs.name: Oasis Hermit

t: Drifter: I came here for the quiet. And the coconuts.
npcs.name: Drifter

t: Fan: The Canyon Coliseum is the loudest place in Dustara. You can hear it from the Oasis!
Fan: The lobby's right inside the gate.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Canyon Scout: Coliseum champs train out on the canyon trails. Sun-baked and battle-ready.
npcs.name: Canyon Scout

t: Snack Trader: Cactus chips! Get your cactus chips! Perfect for cheering.
npcs.name: Snack Trader

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Canyon Coliseum! The arena is straight through those doors.
Receptionist: Heal up before you step in. The crowd loves a good long match!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I've seen every match this season. Okay, most of them. Okay, three.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Prospector: Red Rock Caves are just ahead. Bring a light, partner.
Prospector: The rocks glow red when the sun hits 'em. Pretty as a sunset.
npcs.name: Prospector

t: Hiker: I'm turning back to Mesa Junction. Those caves are too twisty for me!
npcs.name: Hiker

t: Miner: Red Rock B1. Magma-types like the warm walls in here.
Miner: Keep going down if you're brave. B2's even toastier.
npcs.name: Miner

t: Spelunker: You're in B2. The Depths are just below. I can hear something rumbling!
Spelunker: Don't forget to check the stash crates along the walls.
npcs.name: Spelunker

t: Rock Hound: Welcome to the Depths! I found three shiny rocks today. Well, two shiny, one kinda dull.
npcs.name: Rock Hound

t: Tea Master: Welcome to the Cactus Tea House. Our prickly pear tea is famous!
Tea Master: Sip slowly. It's spicier than it looks.
npcs.name: Tea Master

t: Regular: I come here every afternoon to dodge the desert heat.
npcs.name: Regular

t: Rock Collector: Welcome to my Den! Every rock here has a name. That one's Gerald.
Rock Collector: Bring me a rock from the canyons sometime. I love surprises.
npcs.name: Rock Collector

t: Rune Carver: The Rune Workshop carves glyphs into canyon stone. Each one is a little story.
Rune Carver: Mind the dust. It gets everywhere!
npcs.name: Rune Carver

t: Apprentice: I've carved forty runes today. Thirty-nine are crooked.
npcs.name: Apprentice

t: Resident: Mirefen Lane Homes are built on stilts above the bog. Dry and cozy!
Resident: The spaceport and the village are both close by.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I jumped from lily pad to lily pad all the way home! Splash!
npcs.name: Kid

t: Old Resident: Mirefen Quiet Court is peaceful. Just frogs and glow moths.
Old Resident: Sporelake Shore is just down the path.
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Neighbour: I hum to my mushrooms. They grow better with a little music.
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Farmer: Mirefen Farmstead grows bog rice and swamp beans. Wet work!
Farmer: There's a secret grove out back. Don't tell anyone I told you.
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: I wade through the rice paddies every morning. My boots are always squishy!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Herbalist: Welcome to my Herbalist Hut! Herbs for every sniffle and sneeze.
Herbalist: Mushroom tea cures almost anything. Except boredom.
npcs.name: Herbalist

t: Helper: I sort the herbs by smell. Some smell like socks.
npcs.name: Helper

t: Botanist: The Spore Lab studies how mushrooms glow. Fascinating stuff!
Botanist: Please don't sniff the samples. Trust me.
npcs.name: Botanist

t: Lab Assistant: I counted spores all day. My eyes are glowing now.
npcs.name: Lab Assistant

t: Resident: Welcome to my Marsh Cottage! It's small, but the lily pads out back are lovely.
Resident: Want some swamp tea? It's better than it sounds.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Swimmer: Sporelake Shore! The lake glows blue at night.
Swimmer: Mirefen Quiet Court is just back up the path.
npcs.name: Swimmer

t: Bog Hiker: Hydro-types splash around the shore. Bring a Volt-type!
npcs.name: Bog Hiker

t: Botanist: Every lantern in this marsh is a living fungus. Don't pick them. They bite back.
Bog hiker: Wild aliens jump out of the reeds. Stick to the dirt paths if your team is tired.
Bog Hiker: Mushroom Maze Cave is just through there. Easy to get lost!
Bog Hiker: Sporecap Overlook is back up the trail.
npcs.name: Bog Hiker

t: Explorer: Mark your path with the glowing caps. That's how I get home!
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Spore Tender: Mushroom Maze B1. The glow caps point the way down.
Spore Tender: Toxin-types hide in the stinky corners. Pack Cure Spray!
npcs.name: Spore Tender

t: Mycologist: These bridges grow on their own. The mushrooms knit the planks back together each night.
Explorer: The Deep Chamber! The biggest mushroom I've ever seen lives down here.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Wanderer: Mirefen Secret Grove! Hidden right behind the farmstead.
Wanderer: Rare Bio-types nap under the giant caps here.
npcs.name: Wanderer

t: Spore Tender: Shhh! The glow moths are sleeping.
npcs.name: Spore Tender

t: Botanist: Glowcap Meadow! Every mushroom here glows a different color.
Botanist: Bog Fork is just down the path.
npcs.name: Botanist

t: Picnicker: I lay down here to watch the caps glow. Best show in Sporeholm!
npcs.name: Picnicker

t: Spore tender: The Mushroom Maze is just ahead. Left at the glowing caps... or was it right?
Wanderer: Trainers watch the paths. Step into their line of sight and it's a battle.
Fisher: Bogwater Bend! The water is murky, but the fish are friendly.
Fisher: Lantern Marsh Shore is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Fisher

t: Bog Hiker: Hydro-types and Toxin-types share this bend. Bring a mix!
npcs.name: Bog Hiker

t: Pilgrim: Listen... the Spore Choir. The pools sing when the spores rise. Some say the tower answers.
Spore tender: The big lily pads hold your weight. Mostly. Hop across them to reach the tower path.
Fan: Mycelium Bowl! The arena is made of a giant mushroom cap!
Fan: The lobby's right inside the stem doors.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Spore Tender: The Relay Tower is next door. It glows extra bright on match nights.
npcs.name: Spore Tender

t: Bog Hiker: Capstep Rise is just back up the path.
npcs.name: Bog Hiker

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Mycelium Bowl! The arena is just ahead.
Receptionist: The floor is a little squishy. Mind your step!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I brought spore lanterns to wave! The glow matches my team!
npcs.name: Fan

t: Fan: The Sporeholm Relay Tower! The mushrooms around it glow brighter every day.
Fan: The trial floor is just inside, past the glowing caps.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Tower Guard: Bring a Plasma-type if you have one. Bio-types don't like the heat!
npcs.name: Tower Guard

t: Dock Tech: Thalassa Spaceport! Ships land right next to the boat docks.
Dock Tech: Port Saltreach Docks is just past the gate.
npcs.name: Dock Tech

t: Traveller: I came by spaceship, but I'm leaving by boat. Adventure!
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Resident: Saltreach Lane Homes face the sea. You can hear the waves all night.
Resident: Saltreach Market is just down the street.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I found a crab in my shoe this morning. I named him Pinchy!
npcs.name: Kid

t: Neighbour: The boardwalk is just around the corner if you want to stroll.
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Old Resident: Saltreach Quiet Court is peaceful. Just gulls and waves.
Old Resident: There's a secret grove out back. Lovely palm trees!
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Fisher: I fish off my porch every morning. Mostly I catch seaweed.
npcs.name: Fisher

t: Farmer: Saltreach Farmstead grows sea grapes and kelp. Salty and delicious!
Farmer: Lagoon Fork is just down the path.
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: I feed the farm critters seaweed snacks. They love them!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Harbormaster: Welcome to the Harbormaster's Office. I keep track of every boat in port.
Harbormaster: The harbor's busy today. Three ships in, two out, and one lost hat.
npcs.name: Harbormaster

t: Sailor: I'm here to sign in my boat. The paperwork takes longer than the trip!
npcs.name: Sailor

t: Fishmonger: Fresh fish! Caught this morning! Well, most of it.
Fishmonger: My best customers are hungry Alienmon. They pay in smiles.
npcs.name: Fishmonger

t: Shopper: I just want one fish. Why are there so many kinds?
npcs.name: Shopper

t: Ship's Mate: This is the Captain's Cabin. Maps, compasses, and lots of seashells.
Ship's Mate: The captain's out at sea. I'm keeping things tidy until they're back.
npcs.name: Ship's Mate

t: Wanderer: Saltreach Secret Grove! Palm trees and sea breeze. Perfect!
Wanderer: Rare Hydro-types nap in the shady pools here.
npcs.name: Wanderer

t: Picnicker: I found this place behind the Quiet Court. Best picnic spot ever!
npcs.name: Picnicker

t: Beachcomber: The coral bars connect at low tide. Hop the bridges and you'll stay dry.
Swimmer: My Alienmon love the shallows. Low-level ones, sure, but they never stop splashing.
SEA ARCH COVE. Quiet waters. Something very large sleeps beneath the arch. Please do not wake it.
Researcher: Readings spike under the arch at night. Whatever sleeps there is enormous.
Pilgrim: Walk softly here. The islanders leave shells at the shrines so Anchorath sleeps on.
Lookout: Helix divers were poking around the cove. I chased them off with a bucket.

objects.why: Open Water Shore dead end reward

t: Surfer: Open Water Shore! The waves here are perfect for surfing.
Surfer: Coral Cove is just back that way.
npcs.name: Surfer

t: Swimmer: Hydro-types surf the waves right alongside me!
npcs.name: Swimmer

t: Castaway: Saw an old wreck off the south rocks. Nobody's dared dive it yet.
Sailor: Harbor Tower is past the sea arch. Captain Marsh doesn't go easy on anyone.
Beachcomber: The Sea Cave is just through there. The tide flows right in!
Beachcomber: Dune Stairway is back up the path.
npcs.name: Beachcomber

t: Explorer: Bring a Volt-type. Hydro-types love those caves.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Sailor: B1 of the Sea Cave. Mind the puddles. Some of them bite.
Sailor: The way down to B2 is past the tide pools.
npcs.name: Sailor

t: Diver: B2! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The water glows blue down there.
npcs.name: Diver

t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! I can hear the waves crashing above us.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Captain's Log, faded: 'The arch woke again tonight. The water glowed blue all the way to the tower.'
The rest of the page is water-stained.
Keeper's aide: The stairs up top lead out onto the coral sand bars. Watch for the tide.
Lamp tender: This light guided the fishing fleet for a hundred years. Helix ships ignore it.
Fan: Tidewater Arena! Battles with the sea spray in your face!
Fan: The lobby's right through the dock doors.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Sailor: The Harbor Relay Tower is just next door. You can see it from the boats!
npcs.name: Sailor

t: Snack Trader: Fish sticks! Fresh from the harbor! Get 'em while they're hot!
npcs.name: Snack Trader

t: Receptionist: Welcome to Tidewater Arena! The Battle Room is just past the lobby.
Receptionist: Hydro-types make a big splash here. Literally!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I got soaked in the front row last time. Best seats in the house!
npcs.name: Fan

t: Fan: The Harbor Relay Tower! It lights the way for ships at night.
Fan: Climb inside to the trial floor. The sea breeze follows you up!
npcs.name: Fan

t: Tower Guard: Hydro-types rule this tower. Bring Volt or Bio types if you've got 'em!
npcs.name: Tower Guard

t: Boat Builder: Saltreach Boathouse. We build and fix all the boats in the harbor.
Boat Builder: Hmm, the back door's been open a lot lately. Strange.
npcs.name: Boat Builder

t: Dockhand: Dune Junction is just up the path.
npcs.name: Dockhand

t: Helix Scientist: Ugh, the boathouse door again. This lab is very damp and very private.
Helix Scientist: Look, I just study fish. Mostly fish. Please don't touch the tanks.
npcs.name: Helix Scientist

t: Beachcomber: Driftwood Hollows! The waves wash up all sorts of treasures here.
Beachcomber: Tidal Inlet is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Beachcomber

t: Swimmer: I built a fort out of driftwood! Wanna see?
npcs.name: Swimmer

t: Dock Tech: Neonis Spaceport! Ships land right on the neon pads.
Dock Tech: The Starport is just through the gate.
npcs.name: Dock Tech

t: Traveller: I came for the arcades. I'm leaving with zero Stardust and a giant plush toy.
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Resident: Neonis Lane Homes. Little apartments with big glowing signs.
Resident: Neon Boulevard is just down the street.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: My window faces a giant sign. It's always daytime in my room!
npcs.name: Kid

t: Old Resident: Neonis Quiet Court is the only dark spot in the city. Lovely, isn't it?
Old Resident: Neon Crossroads is close by.
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Cat Owner: My cat stares at the neon all night. I think it likes the colours.
npcs.name: Cat Owner

t: Farmer: Neonis Farmstead Edge grows glowing lettuce under the city lights!
Farmer: The Megadome is right next door. Very noisy at night!
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: I feed the glow sheep every morning. They sparkle when they're happy!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Dish tech: These antennas relay DJ Static's show to the whole system. Someone keeps hijacking channel 9.
Hiker: The glowing grass is full of wild Alienmon. Keep a few Stasis Pods handy.
Radio fan: DJ Static picked up a signal coming from the Starfall Rift. It repeats every 8 seconds.
Raver: Voltspire is just east. Static's apprentices guard the first floor. They're loud. Really loud.
Courier: The Undercity Tunnels are down there. Dark and full of old wires!
Courier: Skyline Overlook is back up the stairs.
npcs.name: Courier

t: Coder: I'm fixing the tunnel signs. They keep saying 'ERROR' instead of 'EXIT'.
npcs.name: Coder

t: Explorer: B1 of the Undercity. Volt-types chew on the old cables down here.
Explorer: The stairs to B2 are past the old train car.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Repair Tech: B2 already! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Spooky hum down there.
npcs.name: Repair Tech

t: Tunnel Rat: The Deep Chamber! I live down here. Rent's cheap.
npcs.name: Tunnel Rat

t: Fan: Voltspire Plaza! The Relay Tower crackles with lightning.
Fan: Step through the doors to the trial floor. Sparks fly in there!
npcs.name: Fan

t: Tower Guard: Volt-types rule this tower. Bring a Gravity-type or something that grounds them!
npcs.name: Tower Guard

t: Raver: The plaza lights pulse to the beat of the tower. Dance with me!
npcs.name: Raver

t: Gardener: Glowgarden Hideaway! Plants that glow like neon signs!
Gardener: Rare Alienmon nap under the bright leaves.
npcs.name: Gardener

t: Visitor: I found this place off Canal Fork. Shhh, keep it a secret!
npcs.name: Visitor

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Helix Front Office. Please take a number.
Receptionist: The lab in the back is for staff only. Supposedly.
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Visitor: I came here to complain about the noise. Nobody's listening.
npcs.name: Visitor

t: Helix Scientist: Oh no, a visitor. Please don't touch the screens. They're very sensitive.
Helix Scientist: I'm just running a test. Nothing to see. Okay, a little to see.
npcs.name: Helix Scientist

t: Boater: The Static Canal fizzes with Volt energy. Don't dip your toes in!
Boater: Arcade Alleys is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Boater

t: Fisher: I fish here every night. I mostly catch glowing boots.
npcs.name: Fisher

t: Fan: Neon Megadome! The lights flash with every hit. So cool!
Fan: The lobby's right through the glowing doors.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Raver: I came for the battles. I stayed for the light show.
npcs.name: Raver

t: Snack Trader: Glow pops! Get your glow pops! They sparkle in your mouth!
npcs.name: Snack Trader

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Neon Megadome! The Battle Floor is just ahead.
Receptionist: Sunglasses are recommended. The lights are very bright!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I painted my face with glowing paint. My mom will be thrilled.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Producer: The Recording Studio! We record Sonic-type songs here.
Producer: Listen to that beat! Sonic-types are total naturals.
npcs.name: Producer

t: Singer: I'm practicing my high notes. LA LA LAAAA! How was that?
npcs.name: Singer

t: Noodle Chef: Welcome to the Noodle Bar! Spicy, sweet, or extra glowing?
Noodle Chef: Slurping is allowed. Encouraged, even!
npcs.name: Noodle Chef

t: Regular: I come here every night after work. The noodles never disappoint.
npcs.name: Regular

t: Resident: Dig Camp Lane Homes. We live in tents and huts close to the dig.
Resident: The farmstead is just down the path.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I dug a hole so deep I found another hole!
npcs.name: Kid

t: Farmer: We grow date palms and sand beans. Desert farming takes patience!
Farmer: The crossroads is just over the hill.
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: My job is to chase Swarm-types off the date palms. They're sneaky!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Old Resident: Dig Camp Quiet Court is where retired diggers rest their backs.
Old Resident: Ruin Crossroads is close by if you need to head out.
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Storyteller: Sit by the fire tonight and I'll tell you about the old glyph kings.
npcs.name: Storyteller

t: Wanderer: Tall grass grows thick between the ruins. Wild Alienmon hide in every patch.
Dock Tech: Glyphos Spaceport! Sand storms make landing an adventure.
Dock Tech: Ruin Crossroads is right outside the gate.
npcs.name: Dock Tech

t: Traveller: I came to see the ruins. I brought a hat and three water bottles.
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Archaeologist: The Drowned Grotto is below. Half the ruins down there are underwater!
Archaeologist: Hydro-types are everywhere. Bring a Volt-type if you can.
npcs.name: Archaeologist

t: Rune Scholar: Glyph Steps is back up the stairs. Mind the moss!
npcs.name: Rune Scholar

t: Diver: B1's pools are deeper than they look. Stick to the dry stones.

Archivist: Shelves on the left are old. Shelves on the right are older.
npcs.name: Archivist

t: Scholar: I've been reading the same page for an hour. The words are tiny!
npcs.name: Scholar

t: Resident: Fragment Lane Homes are built on floating crystal pieces.
Resident: Crystal Crossroads is just down the path.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I found a crystal that sings! Wanna hear? La la la!
npcs.name: Kid

t: Neighbour: Arrival Fragment is close by if you just landed.
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Old Resident: Fragment Quiet Court. The Recovery Bay and the shop are right here!
Old Resident: The crystals hum softly at night. Lovely sound.
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Neighbour: I water my crystal garden every morning. They grow so slowly!
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Farmer: Seedfall Farmstead grows plants from seeds that fell from the sky!
Farmer: Glasswood Hollows is just down the path.
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: I feed the farm critters crystal crumbs. They sparkle when they eat!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Rift Walker: Shard Slope! Crystal shards cover every step. Watch your feet!
Rift Walker: Red Sun Overlook is just back up the path.
npcs.name: Rift Walker

t: Hiker: The shards ring like bells when the wind blows!
npcs.name: Hiker

t: Wanderer: Ystra Secret Grove! Crystal trees that chime in the breeze.
Wanderer: Rare Alienmon nap under the glowing branches.
npcs.name: Wanderer

t: Seeker: I found this place off Void Fork. It feels very old.
npcs.name: Seeker

t: Rift Walker: Shardheart Cave is just through there. The crystals inside are huge!
Rift Walker: Void Crack Bend is back up the path.
npcs.name: Rift Walker

t: Seeker: Crystal-types guard the cave. Bring something strong!
npcs.name: Seeker

t: Crystal Hunter: 1F of Shardheart Cave. The walls sparkle with every step.
Crystal Hunter: The way down to B1 is past the big crystal pillar.
npcs.name: Crystal Hunter

t: Explorer: B1! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The crystals glow brighter down there.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Seeker: The Deep Chamber! I've never seen crystals this big.
npcs.name: Seeker

t: Seeker: The Ancient Crystal Ring! Battles here echo through the crystal walls.
Seeker: The lobby is just through the shining arch.
npcs.name: Seeker

t: Rift Walker: This ring is older than anything else on Ystra. Can you feel it?
npcs.name: Rift Walker

t: Pilgrim: Glasswood Junction is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Pilgrim

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Crystal Ring! The arena is just ahead.
Receptionist: The crystals hum louder during big battles. Listen for it!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I came all the way from Halo to watch a match here!
npcs.name: Fan

t: Dock Tech: Ystra Spaceport! The oldest landing pad you'll ever see.
Dock Tech: Glasswood Junction is just past the gate.
npcs.name: Dock Tech

t: Traveller: I made it all the way to Ystra! Now where's the snack stand?
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Nurse: Welcome to the Fragment Recovery Bay. Your team will feel brand new in no time.
Nurse: All rested! The crystals hum happily when Alienmon are healthy.
npcs.name: Nurse

t: Visitor: My team napped right through the healing. Best rest ever!
npcs.name: Visitor

t: Clerk: Welcome to the Fragment Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and supplies for the crystal paths.
Clerk: Shards are sharp out there. Pack extra Potions!
npcs.name: Clerk

t: Vault Keeper: The Seed Vault keeps seeds from every world. Every single one!
Vault Keeper: Please keep the doors closed. The seeds like it cool.
npcs.name: Vault Keeper

t: Researcher: I'm cataloguing seeds. Seed number 4,207 looks just like 4,206.
npcs.name: Researcher

t: Caretaker: This Ancient Dwelling is older than anything else on Ystra.
Caretaker: Someone lived here long, long ago. They liked crystal furniture!
npcs.name: Caretaker

t: Memory Keeper: The Memory Hall holds echoes of all the worlds. Listen closely.
Memory Keeper: Some echoes are happy, some are sad. All are worth hearing.
npcs.name: Memory Keeper

t: Seeker: I came here to remember. I forgot what, though.
npcs.name: Seeker

t: Resident: Gravewell Lane Homes. Every house has a lantern by the door.
Resident: Gravewell's just down the road.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I'm not scared of the dark! Okay, maybe a little.
npcs.name: Kid

t: Old Resident: Gravewell Quiet Court. The quietest spot in a very quiet world.
Old Resident: Even the shadows whisper here.
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Neighbour: I polish my lantern every evening. It's my favorite chore.
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Farmer: Umbra Farmstead Edge grows shadow mushrooms. They taste like midnight!
Farmer: Sinkhole Overlook is just up the path.
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: My farm critters glow faintly in the dark. Makes them easy to find!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Dock Tech: Umbra Spaceport! Ships land by lantern light here.
Dock Tech: Shadow Junction is just past the gate.
npcs.name: Dock Tech

t: Traveller: I came to see the lanterns. They're even prettier than the pictures!
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Lantern keeper: Every lantern on this street is tended by hand. Miss one night and the shadows creep in.
Scavenger: Trainers on these streets watch from the dark. Walk into their line of sight and they'll call you out.
Pilgrim: The Sinkhole is just east. They say a Signal Shard sleeps at the very bottom.
Drifter: Past the Sinkhole stands Gravewell Tower. The Keeper there fights with the dark itself.
Drifter: Mistfall Bend! The mist is so thick you can barely see your feet.
Drifter: Gloom Commons is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Drifter

t: Lantern Keeper: Hold your lantern high. The mist hides the path.
npcs.name: Lantern Keeper

objects.why: hidden grove reward (rock before the blue flower bed)

t: Wanderer: Gloomshade Grove! Trees with black leaves that glow faintly.
Wanderer: Rare Void-types nap in the deep shadows here.
npcs.name: Wanderer

t: Lantern Keeper: I found this place off Abyss Fork. Keep your lantern close!
npcs.name: Lantern Keeper

t: Scavenger: The Helix Hideout. They thought nobody could find it in the dark.
Scavenger: There's a lab in the back. Smells like burnt wires.
npcs.name: Scavenger

t: Lantern Keeper: The Relay Tower is close by. Follow the lanterns!
npcs.name: Lantern Keeper

t: Helix Scientist: Who turned on the lights?! I was working in the dark on purpose.
Helix Scientist: Fine, look around. Just don't open the shadow jars.
npcs.name: Helix Scientist

t: Fan: The Lantern Pit! Battles lit only by lanterns. So spooky and cool!
Fan: The lobby's right inside the lantern gate.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Lantern Keeper: Keep to the lanterns. The dark makes everything look bigger.
npcs.name: Lantern Keeper

t: Scavenger: Abyss Rim is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Scavenger

t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Lantern Pit! The arena is just ahead.
Receptionist: Void-types love the shadows in there. Watch out!
npcs.name: Receptionist

t: Fan: I brought my own lantern so I can see every move!
npcs.name: Fan

t: Drifter: The Wailing Cave is just through there. It's called that for a reason!
Drifter: Shade Hollows is back up the path.
npcs.name: Drifter

t: Explorer: The wailing is just the wind. Probably.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Lantern Bearer: B1 of the Wailing Cave. Keep your lantern lit and your team close.
Lantern Bearer: The way down to B2 is past the moaning tunnel.
npcs.name: Lantern Bearer

t: Spelunker: B2! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The wailing gets louder down there!
npcs.name: Spelunker

t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! The wailing stopped. That's either good or very spooky.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Fan: The Gravewell Relay Tower! The lanterns around it never go out.
Fan: The trial floor waits inside, lit by a hundred lanterns.
npcs.name: Fan

t: Tower Guard: Void-types rule this tower. Bring your brightest team!
npcs.name: Tower Guard

t: Lantern Maker: Welcome to the Lantern Maker's Shop! Every lantern here is handmade.
Lantern Maker: A good lantern keeps the dark away. And the Void-types guessing!
npcs.name: Lantern Maker

t: Customer: I'm buying a lantern for every room in my house. Even the closet.
npcs.name: Customer

t: Innkeeper: This is the Shadow Inn. Rest your feet and your team!
Innkeeper: The beds are soft and the lanterns stay on all night.
npcs.name: Innkeeper

t: Traveller: I slept for twelve hours. The dark makes everyone sleepy!
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Caretaker: This study belongs to someone who loves old books. Lots and lots of old books.
Caretaker: Please put things back where you found them. They notice.
npcs.name: Caretaker

t: Dock Tech: Starfall Spaceport! Ships land right near the crater rim.
Dock Tech: Rift Fork is just past the gate.
npcs.name: Dock Tech

t: Traveller: I came to see the crater glow. It's even better in person!
npcs.name: Traveller

t: Resident: Starfall Lane Homes are right by Rim Camp. The shop's just around the corner!
Resident: The crater glows purple on clear nights.
npcs.name: Resident

t: Kid: I saw a shooting star last night! I wished for a Gravity-type.
npcs.name: Kid

t: Neighbour: Crater Crossroads is close by if you need to head out.
npcs.name: Neighbour

t: Old Resident: Starfall Quiet Court. Quiet, except when the crater hums.
Old Resident: There's a secret grove down the path. Lovely sparkly trees!
npcs.name: Old Resident

t: Stargazer: I count the stars every night. I'm up to seven thousand.
npcs.name: Stargazer

t: Farmer: Starfall Farmstead Edge grows crater corn. It glows a little when it's ripe!
Farmer: The arena's right next door. Loud on match nights!
npcs.name: Farmer

t: Farm Kid: I feed the farm critters seedpod crumbs. They love it!
npcs.name: Farm Kid

t: Rift Seeker: Rift Edge! Don't lean too far. The crater goes way down.
Rift Seeker: Rift Fork is just back that way.
npcs.name: Rift Seeker

t: Hiker: Void-types sometimes peek out from the cracks. Spooky!
npcs.name: Hiker

Seedpod Hunter: Some still glow faintly. Pretty, right?
npcs.name: Seedpod Hunter

t: Star Watcher: Rift Fork is just back the way you came.
npcs.name: Star Watcher

t: Snack Trader: Star crunch bars! Sweet, crunchy, and a little sparkly!
npcs.name: Snack Trader

t: Fan: I brought a telescope to watch the battles. Is that weird?
npcs.name: Fan

t: Rift Seeker: Starstone Hollow is just through there. The rocks twinkle like stars!

npcs.name: Rift Seeker

npcs.name: Rock Hound

t: Star Watcher: B1 of Starstone Hollow. Crystal-types grow right out of the walls.

npcs.name: Star Watcher

t: Explorer: B2 already! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The glow gets stronger!
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! It's like standing inside a star.
npcs.name: Explorer

t: Clerk: Welcome to the Starfall Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and supplies for the crater.

npcs.name: Clerk

t: Greenhouse Keeper: The Seedpod Greenhouse grows plants from crater seeds.
Greenhouse Keeper: Some sprout overnight. Some take years. Patience!
npcs.name: Greenhouse Keeper

t: Gardener: I watered a seedpod and it giggled. I think.
npcs.name: Gardener

t: Star Watcher: The Observation Post watches the crater day and night.
Star Watcher: Look through the scope! You might spot a shooting star.
npcs.name: Star Watcher

t: Assistant: I write down every twinkle. My notebook is full of dots.
npcs.name: Assistant

t: Helix Scientist: This is a field office. A perfectly normal field office. Please leave.
Helix Scientist: Okay, fine, look around. Just don't touch the drill charts.
npcs.name: Helix Scientist

npcs.name: Bog walker
